meta.title: Security and Data Protection | DocumentoIQ
meta.description: Learn how DocumentoIQ protects your information with Google Cloud infrastructure, advanced encryption, and granular access control.

hero.title: The trust behind DocumentoIQ
hero.subtitle: Every processed document is backed by secure infrastructure, reliable technologies and best practices designed to protect information at every stage of the document process.
hero.microcopy: Enterprise infrastructure · Data protection · Responsible AI

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure designed to protect your information
infrastructure.description: DocumentoIQ runs on Google Cloud enterprise infrastructure, leveraging managed services and international standards to provide a secure, stable platform prepared for organisations that process sensitive information.

benefits.title: What does this mean for you or your organisation?
items: Physical and logical protection managed by Google
Scalability to support the growth of your operation

protection.title: Information protection at every stage of the process
protection.description: From document upload through processing and storage, DocumentoIQ protects information using modern security and encryption mechanisms.

transit.title: Secure communication
transit.description: All information travels through encrypted connections.

rest.title: Protected storage
rest.description: Documents and metadata remain encrypted while stored in the infrastructure.

signedUrls.title: Temporary document access
signedUrls.description: Uploads and downloads use temporary links that reduce information exposure.

access.title: Controlled access to your information
access.description: DocumentoIQ incorporates authentication and control mechanisms to protect access to information throughout the document process.

authentication.title: Secure authentication
authentication.description: Access protected through modern authentication mechanisms.

session.title: Session management
session.description: Sessions are managed automatically to reduce the risk of unauthorised access.

pbac.title: Access permissions
pbac.description: Each user only views information authorised according to their configuration.

isolation.title: Information isolation
isolation.description: Each organisation keeps its information separate within the platform.

audit.title: Advanced capabilities
audit.description: Implementations can incorporate additional administration, auditing and integration controls according to the organisation's needs.

ai.title: Responsible AI for document processing
ai.description: DocumentoIQ uses Artificial Intelligence providers with enterprise security and privacy standards. Processed information remains protected and is not used to train public models.

items.purpose: Specialised processing according to the document workflow

important.title: Important
important.description: DocumentoIQ does not use unmanaged open models or providers without a formal security posture.

ai.closing: At DocumentoIQ, AI is a tool for understanding documents; security and control over information always remain in the hands of the platform and those who use it.

responsibleUse.title: Responsible use of AI
responsibleUse.description: Models are used in inference mode to process documents, not to train models with customer information.

cta.title: Do you have questions about security or compliance?
cta.description: Our team can help answer questions about DocumentoIQ's architecture, security practices and information processing.
cta.microcopy: Available for due diligence processes and provider evaluations.

items.question: Who can access my documents?
items.answer: Only users authorised according to the platform configuration.

items.question: What happens if I stop using DocumentoIQ?
items.answer: There is a formal procedure for permanently deleting each company's data.

items.question: How does DocumentoIQ protect my information?
items.answer: Through enterprise infrastructure, encryption and security controls throughout the document process.

items.question: Need more information?
items.answer: Our team can help answer any questions about security and data protection.
